purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt/medical billing software) system. It generates a list of available patient numbers (empty patient number list) for a Japanese medical institution. It reads system management master data, constructs patient number formats, handles printing management, and writes error output to an error file.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical association receipt software)

verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but contains Japanese multi-byte characters (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), causing the comment and string literal text to appear as mojibake. The program logic is clearly readable despite this. The COPY statements reference many external copybooks not shown here, so full data structure analysis is incomplete. The program is part of the well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt system ORCA, which is a real production system. No COMP-3 usage detected despite being a financial/billing domain program, which is somewhat unusual but consistent with GnuCOBOL usage patterns.
